text:
anna_marketing: Quick sync — we need an updated field brief vs cloud AI platforms / LLM APIs / infra vendors for the webinar and SDR plays. I'm porting the benchmark narrative into slides. Anyone have 3–4 crisp competitive bullets + 1-line objection responses?

sam_sales: High level priorities from GTM: 1) when to pick Redwood (predictable latency + cost controls), 2) when to pick a cloud platform (tight ecosystem), 3) when infra vendor wins (full ops control). I can draft the sales-facing 3 bullets per competitor.

jordan_product: Add a runtime/kernel differentiator line — e.g., 'GPU-optimized serving with automated kernel selection + KV caching = stable p95 at scale'. Keep it one sentence for battlecard.

lee_research: Benchmarks update: re-ran throughput vs CloudX endpoints yesterday — ~2.4x lower p95 cost at 512-token median with batching and prefix cache. Will attach methodology (load shape, model family, quantization).

sasha_mktops: Important: inbound routing ask — tag webinar registrants who download the benchmark as "bench-interested" and route to SDR if company_size >= 200. Proposed HubSpot rule below:

```
IF event = "webinar_reg" AND asset = "benchmark_pdf" THEN
  add_tag("bench-interested");
  IF company_size >= 200 THEN assign_to(team = "SDR", owner = "sam_sales") ELSE assign_to(team = "nurture");
  add_lead_source("benchmark_webinar_campaign_v2");
```

sam_sales: Objection play: when prospects say "we have cloud credits" — reply: "Credits lower up-front cost but don't buy predictable latency, rollout controls, or the SLOs + support we provide. We help reduce per-token spend while keeping latency SLOs intact — see case: Acme Corp cut p95 by 30% after switching routing/caching."

anna_marketing: For the webinar deck: slide 4 = cost vs latency tradeoff heatmap + one-line callout on batching + caching. Slide 6 = quick triage table (who should pick Redwood vs alternatives). We should avoid raw numbers in public slides.

lee_research: Agreed on avoiding absolutes publicly. I'll produce an internal appendix with raw results and the test harness. Internal memo will include safe % ranges we can cite.

jordan_product: UX ask for battlecard: one-row per buy signal (speed, cost, control, compliance) and 3 short ticks per competitor. Example row: Speed — Redwood: "stable p95 with continuous batching"; Cloud AI: "fast single-call latency but variable at scale"; Infra vendor: "depends on customer ops maturity".

sasha_mktops: I'll update the battlecard doc in Drive and push a flattened PDF for SDRs. Also adding routing: webhook -> /marketing/inbound, add tag "ga:benchmark-webinar", assign to sam_sales if company_size > 500.

sam_sales: @anna_marketing I'll draft the objection kit (3 bullets per competitor) + 2 outreach templates for SDRs to use post-webinar.

deploy_bot: deployed: /marketing/inbound routing rule v2 (ops ticket #9876) :white_check_mark:

anna_marketing: Great progress. Deadlines: EOW for internal battlecard + one-pager; public webinar narrative draft by next Tue. @lee_research can you confirm allowed % ranges and attach methodology by Fri?

lee_research: Confirmed — will send internal memo with methods, raw tables, and suggested % ranges by Fri EOD.

anna_marketing: Thanks team — once internal doc is in Drive I'll request a quick review slot for slides. :thumbsup:
